summary: All 5 phases complete. Created Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Embedding.lean with PropositionalEmbedding typeclass, PL.Proposition.embed skeleton (structural on atom/bot/imp; Łukasiewicz on and/or), five @[simp] rfl lemmas, single classical-scope limitation note (Wajsberg1938/McKinsey1939), and uninstantiated NativePropositionalEmbedding extension point. Rewrote toModal/toTemporal/toBimodal as thin φ.embed wrappers. All toX_* simp/grind lemmas preserved verbatim as rfl. Triplicated notes collapsed to one-line pointers. Task 417 coordination: Temporal and Bimodal bridge proofs required no repointing — Task 417's evaluate_iff_of_classicalBridge abstraction already handles embedding definitionally. Full CI green.

verification.notes: Pre-existing sorry in Temporal/Minimal/Completeness.lean not introduced by this task. Temporal/Bimodal bridge repoint not needed (Task 417 covered it). No lint warnings in modified files.

task_417_coordination: No merge conflict — Task 417 already abstracted conservativity proofs via evaluate_iff_of_classicalBridge, which reduces through the PropositionalEmbedding instances definitionally. The bridge proofs in ConservativeExtension.lean and PropositionalConservativity.lean needed no simp-repoint.
design_decision: Typeclass-carried atomEmbed with outParam Atom: class PropositionalEmbedding (Atom : outParam Type*) (F : Type*) [HasBot F] [HasImp F]. This allows Atom to be inferred from the target type F via the instance, keeping all toX := φ.embed wrappers unambiguous.
